hook: Window seat booked for your cat.
caption:
#ad Consider this carrier a first-class ticket for hands-free vet visits and quick getaways. Breathable mesh panels cover the front and sides, and a rear zippered compartment pops out so your cat can stretch out flat. If you plan to fly together, be sure to check your airline's pet carrier dimensions first.

Find more on the shelf: https://solvix-shelf.pages.dev/

#catcarrier #catbackpack #pettravel #cattravel
brief: Expandable cat backpack carrier: a soft backpack with mesh windows on the front and sides; a panel zips out so the cat has room to stretch. Makes vet trips and short travel hands-free. Honest note: if flying, check your airline's size rules first. Playful tone: the ad is a boarding pass for your cat, window seat booked.
